conceptZh: 扭蛋小怪獸衝過頭，一頭栽進粉紅色的粉末桶，全身變粉紅，第二次輕輕一碰，粉末就排成「米」和「分」組成「粉」。
object: a round fuzzy pocket creature, a big tub of pink powder and a puffy powder cloud
morph: pink powder puffs organize into the left rice part 米 and the right part 分 to form 粉
creativeAngle: 衝過頭：小怪獸全力衝刺栽進粉紅色粉末桶，粉末炸開，第二次輕輕一點粉末才乖乖排成「米」和「分」。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and soft, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-mint-green backdrop with a pale cream floor. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated hot-magenta-pink Traditional Chinese glyph 粉, the 米 component on the left and the 分 component on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original round fuzzy pocket creature, pale-gray at first, with huge eyes and stubby feet, who bursts out of a gachapon capsule and bounces off everything; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the capsule pops open at the left and the creature rockets out at full speed across the floor, far too fast, flies right past a big round tub of fine pink powder, and crashes into the far wall; the first spoken 粉 lands at the crash as a tiny puff of pink powder drifts up from the tub. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the creature bounces back, gets a running start and dives headfirst into the tub; a huge soft pink cloud puffs up, and when it settles the creature is pink from ears to toes, blinking in surprise, two big sneezes shaking out more clouds; the second spoken 粉 lands on the first sneeze. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): embarrassed, it tiptoes up and, with one gentle fingertip tap on the tub's rim, the powder floats up in neat swirls and settles as the left 米 and the right 分, and the word 粉紅 is spoken as the creature looks at its own fur, looks at the glyph, and its cheeks glow rosier still. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 粉 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in magenta pink; the pink creature stands far to the side, patting itself and sending out a tiny puff with each pat, wiggling with delight, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「粉、粉、粉紅」, read as ㄈㄣˇ、ㄈㄣˇ、ㄈㄣˇ ㄏㄨㄥˊ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.8s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft whooshes and puffs under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.

conceptZh: 小外星人的牽引光束想抓粉紅粉撲球，卻反過來把自己的飛碟吊起來亂甩，飛碟在地板、玩具戰士的盾牌、牆壁和天花板之間連環彈跳，每撞一下就「喀」地把一筆敲進位，最後一跳正好坐在拼好的「粉」上，粉撲球砸下來讓他整臉變粉紅。
object: a fluffy hot-pink powder-puff ball on a small pedestal, guarded by a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield
morph: a loose heap of magenta stroke-sticks lies on the floor; each ricochet of the bouncing saucer jolts one stick up to clack into its slot, 米 on the left first, then 分 on the right, until the saucer's last bounce drops it on top of the finished 粉
creativeAngle: 全新彈跳連鎖版：不再是怪獸栽進粉末桶的安靜變色，而是飛碟被自己的光束甩出去，在畫面裡四處彈跳，每一撞敲出一筆，動作連續、因果清楚；玩具戰士只當一個會自轉的「彈板」，粉紅粉撲球最後砸下來讓外星人變粉紅，正好對上「粉紅」這個詞。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated slapstick clip, locked frontal camera, bright soft lighting, no flashing. Setting: a clean pale-butter-yellow backdrop and a pale cream floor, nothing busy behind. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated hot-magenta Traditional Chinese glyph 粉, the 米 component on the left and the 分 component on the right, correctly formed, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. Lead: an original small green cartoon alien with huge eyes and a tiny antenna, piloting a chunky toy flying saucer with a clear dome and a wobbly tractor-beam nozzle underneath; all characters are toys and cartoons, no real people. Supporting character: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and a round shield, all bravado, who stands guard beside a small pedestal holding a fluffy hot-pink powder-puff ball at the right. A loose heap of magenta stroke-sticks lies on the floor at center.

Moment one (0.0-1.5s): the saucer hovers in from the left, the alien stares at the pink puff ball, rubs its hands and aims the tractor beam. The beam grabs the puff ball, which shoots up and bonks the saucer dome with a soft pink dust cloud. The first spoken 粉 lands on that bonk.

Moment two (1.5-3.6s): the alien cranks the beam to full power; the beam loops around and grabs the saucer itself, yanks it straight up and flings it. The saucer ricochets wildly: floor, then the warrior's shield (he swings his foam sword so hard he spins himself in a circle), then the left wall, then the ceiling. Each hit is a clear BONK, and each bonk jolts one magenta stroke-stick up from the heap to clack into its slot, the 米 strokes first on the left, then the 分 strokes on the right. The second spoken 粉 lands as the last stroke snaps in and the glyph 粉 stands complete.

Moment three (3.6-5.0s): one final bounce drops the saucer, upright and wobbling, right on top of the finished 粉; the alien sits dazed with a dizzy grin. The pink puff ball falls from above and plops into its lap, bursting a soft pink cloud, and the alien's green face flushes bright pink. The word 粉紅 is spoken exactly as the alien turns pink. The saucer then tips and glides off to the right side, clearing the strokes.

Hold (5.0-8.0s): the glyph 粉 stays perfectly still, crisp and unobstructed in magenta. At the far right the pink-faced alien hugs the puff ball and does a tiny happy wiggle in the hovering saucer; the warrior sits dizzy on the floor far left, never touching the strokes.

Narration (off-screen only, warm friendly Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「粉、粉、粉紅」, read as ㄈㄣˇ、ㄈㄣˇ、ㄈㄣˇ ㄏㄨㄥˊ, first utterance at about 0.9s, second at about 3.3s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft cartoon boings, clacks and puffs under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
